system.description:
When you use a Force Power, you can spend a Force Point to purify the Force Power. The Force Power gains the [Light Side] descriptor, and opponents who have a Dark Side Score of 1 or higher take a -2 penalty to all Defense Scores against this activation of the Force Power.

Alternatively, you can spend a Destiny Point to increase the penalty to opponents' Defense Scores to -5. You cannot use this Force Secret if you have a Dark Side Score of 1 or higher.

Force Powers that have the [Dark Side] descriptor cannot be purified with this Force Secret.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
